dataset_title: Vincom Retail Annual Report 2024 Vietnamese prose screening
purpose: Exploratory Vietnamese corporate-document OCR CER/WER screening on selected pages from the official Vincom Retail Annual Report 2024.
reference_method: native PDF text layer, extracted in visual reading order; not proofread word by word
reference_quality: The selected pages were visually inspected for narrative content. Native PDF text was extracted with PyMuPDF and has not been proofread against every line; reading order, text mapping, and mixed content may affect CER/WER.
limitations: Twelve selected pages from one born-digital annual report are dependent samples and do not establish broad company or sector coverage.
References come from unproofread native PDF text and may contain extraction order, reading-order, or transcription discrepancies.
Selected pages include photographs, diagrams, callouts, and some tables; full-page CER/WER can reflect non-prose and layout order.
This annual report is born-digital, not a physical scan.
CER/WER measure recognized text only, not layout detection or table extraction.
Exploratory screening only; not eligible for primary model selection.
